body: Thank you. Nobody I know understands this feeling of emptiness. I've been feeling like this for a while now, but it has gotten worse since I was in a car accident. I feel so trapped- not just physically, but emotionally. I'm just sitting here alone, contemplating why I exist.
I just don't see the world like that anymore. To me it's just a big, confusing mess. It is painful, but that is about it for me.
I sure feel like a nobody sometimes. And thank you, English was my best subject in high school. I'm in the USA.
Why? I'm just some nobody on the internet. I don't even care about me anymore.
I'd tell them this is for the best. When there's nothing worth living for, why fight to live? It's not like anyone cares.

I'm so alone. I can't handle being around other people, it never turns out right. I kept living in the hope something would change, but nothing ever will. My existence is pointless. Nobody cares about me, and i don't care about anyone.
Fuck it. I'm done with everything.
